periods.label: Ruins manager and Arcadia survivor guardian
periods.occupation: ruins manager, guardian of old-era survivors

status.role: travels among ruins while raising rescued Arcadia and Sylfa survivors

periods.summary: Old-era survivor who manages and gradually seals the ruins. She rescues children from the ruins, cares for them with Sophis, loves Lux, but chooses not to become a sixth queen for now to avoid increasing his burden.

lux-arcadia.summary: Loves him but postpones any romantic claim until his kingly burden lessens.

sophis-excelf.summary: Travels with her from the Moon ruins to the New Kingdom.

li-prica.summary: Leaves the ruins children in her care during the trip.

airi-arcadia.summary: Airi temporarily cared for an Arcadia baby survivor Ariel found.

key_events.summary: Travels from the Seventh Ruins Moon to the New Kingdom and reunites with Lux after the Hounds incident.
